title: Stability certificates for two exceptional reaction networks
assumptions: Exactly the two networks in Tang-Zhang Example 4, in the reaction order of reactions.json.
Mass-action kinetics; all six rate constants strictly positive.
Positive equilibrium means all three concentrations strictly positive.
Exponential stability means all Jacobian eigenvalues have strictly negative real part.

claims.statement: For each of the two networks and every strictly positive rate vector, there are at most three distinct positive equilibria.
For each network, if there are three distinct positive equilibria, all three are nondegenerate and exactly one is exponentially stable.
For each network and every strictly positive rate vector, at most one positive equilibrium is exponentially stable, including when other positive equilibria are degenerate.

Each of the three fixed rational samples has three nondegenerate positive equilibria and one exponentially stable positive equilibrium. Every archived rational interval and Hurwitz sign is recomputed and compared.

prior_work.Tang-Zhang: The networks, their exceptional role, the bound of three, the 375/373 classification and Lemma 3 belong to Tang-Zhang. The package does not independently audit that classification.
prior_work.Torres-Feliu: The determinant reduction and alternating-stability method specialize Proposition 2 and Theorem 1; they are not a new general principle.

verification_limits: The second implementation was fixed before reading the first derivation, code or outputs, but its task disclosed the expected claims and sample counts.
Network matrices and parameter vectors were shared inputs; this was not independent acquisition of all inputs.
The package preparation and rerun use both implementations; they add no independent mathematical derivation.
The written positivity and root-sign arguments are not checked by a proof assistant.
No human expert review has been completed.
Research commit identifiers and historical hashes record provenance; they do not independently authenticate chronology.
not_claimed: Novelty or priority of the two-network conclusions.
A new classification, elimination method or general stability principle.
A theoretical explanation of the upper bound across all 375 networks, or the common structure of the 373 multistable networks; those questions remain unresolved here.
A new discovery of the two exceptional networks or the 375/373 classification.
Three positive equilibria for every strictly positive rate vector.
Nonlinear asymptotic stability of degenerate equilibria.
A bound on boundary attractors, cycles or all attracting sets.
Dissipativity, global dynamics or biological realizability.
A general-purpose solver or certification of arbitrary parameter vectors.
Human peer review, formal verification, blinded testing or cited-author endorsement.
